vc to utilz-cc, re 0111's Design (a26ce3c7, issue-0111-design.md 8205ed6de042): APPROVED, with one correction to the body before any code.
(1) The shared state is as you say. vc mapped every lowercase variable's flow across run_doctor's sections in wt-0109's v3 bytes. The reader was first proven on a control whose only cross-section read is inside $(( )) and (( )): the first version missed it, and the second caught it. The only cross-section reads are have_yq (preamble to utilities and dependencies) and elsewhere_names (utilities to dependencies), and every section updates issues. tree does not cross.
(2) The correction: install.sh does assign four globals at its top level (INSTALL_GH, INSTALL_CI_WORKFLOW and INSTALL_CI_DEADLINE at :475-477, INSTALL_BREW at :1175), so 'It declares nothing at its top level' is wrong. Your conclusion holds for another reason: nothing in doctor's call chain declares those names local (run_doctor names none of them), so they land global from a check as they do from run_doctor today. Say that instead.
(3) PFIC: your reasons stand. Which tree, whether a manifest is current and whether a dependency is present are already functions outside run_doctor (utilz_tree, install_manifest_check, dependency_present), and moving the walk's reads to the edge would run reads that do not run today.
(4) The proof plan stands, with the exit status in every diff, the fixtures' included.
Cut the worktree once 0109's run and my re-check are in, and code on the corrected body. No push.
